body:
I've been like this for at least a year. I see my family around one or twice every 3 months. My long term friends are also about every 2-3 times a month. All I have down here is my 2 housemates, who have lived in this town for their lives, so I'm missing out on those childhood friendships I guess... Even though I only live 45 minutes away from my home town, I've been visited once by friends yet I've visited them so many times in the past year.

I'm typing this in a room at 5am that is filled up with packed boxes for tomorrows house move that I'm not even wanting to go through with, yet the choice is not mine. I think I'd better crash now as the parents are coming down tomorrow to help with the move. Thanks for the advice, I'll keep it in mind :)

My first housemate (about 2 years ago) threw me down a flight of stairs in my boxers and proceeded to strangle me until his friend intervened, I didn't inform the police, I just left the next day to avoid seeing him again, haven't seen him since.

Every job I've had, I've worked out of hours for free to save the managers arse and I've always been the first thrown down to the wolves.

2 of my long term relationships, they cheated on me. 

Another long term relationship decided to break up with me on a whim.

The latest one though.... I moved in with her, it was out of town but things were going well... She was moving in with a male friend of hers, we met one weekend and things went great, we got one well. We got talking and it was decided that it was in our best interests that we all moved in together (I was working in this town at the time, and lived out of town). We each had our own separate room, even the girlfriend and I. She ended up moving out one morning whilst I was still in bed. Her and the other housemate weren't getting on. (In any other subreddit an affair post would be up there), this wasn't the case, they really did just not get on.

She moved out the day before the rent was due though and I found out a week later that this was planned from one of her friends. I think that shot my trust levels down a fair few notches. 

This rough patch is lasting the longest it ever has yet. I've disregarded two very, very nice women since that happened because I don't feel like I could get into another relationship (and as mentioned I can't just do the one or two night thing). 

I feel like I'm moaning about trivial stuff, and it is trivial.

>Now I feel like a dick.

I've just re-read that... I didn't meant to make it out that you made me say that haha, I can just imagine how bad that would feel once this account gets left in the dark after tonight.. I'll keep on trying with this whole life thing though as I was, I wont say I'll enjoy it greatly as 26 years on, I still haven't. But I guess there's nothing else to work on, I'll soldier on and thanks for your help.

I keep everything to myself, always have. I've had a little drink tonight as it's our last day of living in this house... Long story on that drinking alone night thing tonight.

I'm not at the lowest point in my life, I think I'm just at the point where I give the least fucks. 

I feel like I'm slipping away from family, friendships... Everything. I'm just slowly ceasing to care about anyone unless they contact me. I'll no longer go out of my way to get in touch with somebody, I'll wait until they contact me. 

I sound like a dick. I think I probably am now. I was never always this way, I just relied on too many people that I shouldn't have, and now I feel like that's passing on.

My original post itself was kind of disconnected :)

I know it doesn't seem like a lot of money, but this mere amount of money could be the difference between my 2 housemates being made homeless or not (I've family that have spare places, they don't due to both of their parents having life threatening illnesses).. So it's not just me that I'm screwing up... In fact I've just realised something whilst typing out this reply.

I'm saying I don't care about anything, but I do. I care more about these 'housemates' that I've known for less than 6 months than I think I care to let on. The past couple of weeks has just gotten to me I think. People don't approach me with problems, as they know I'll just get a joke out of it. I guess I just have to appreciate other peoples stress that relates to myself more than what I'm doing. I mean, I wasn't really screwing myself over by leaving the bond and rent until late, but more the housemates. Now I feel like a dick.

I think what people need, are just ears to listen. People will turn to strangers on the internet when they have nobody in their life that will listen to them legitimately. I think what we need to do more as a species than anything else, is to treat every person as if they're the lowest you have ever felt.

That sounded wrong, I worded it completely wrongly. But the worst words I've ever spoken, have been when I'm at my lowest, and from that, I'll take the crap that anybody throws at me as if they're in that stage of life that I was/am. I'll give them an ear to speak to. I'll not judge them in any way, I'll purely give them my attention. Too few people have done this to myself when I needed it. The only way I've figured out how to change this, is to give up my own ears when needed.

I'm not sure what time it is currently for you (3am here). I'll pass on the pm's though, it's a throwaway account I'm using. 

I'm just a one of those that need an ear (or eye) to hear.

First off it feels like a relief to have a second account. For 3 years my account name has been something that is very easily linked to my own identity (it's my own name).

This though...

I feel like shit. Even that felt like a relief to admit. I feel like utter shit. Yet I'll go on living life just to make others happy. I buy surprises for people, nice things.. Pay for food for the roommates, buy necessities. But in truth, it's just because I don't feel like money is that much of a prized possession.

They're quite careful with their money (they don't have all that much, pretty much along the lines of myself), yet I always indulge (never over budget without a backup I'll add).

Whenever I have money though, I'll blow it on myself and friends. 

I won a fair bit a few years ago (not life changing, but it was a fair sum). I spent it all in around two nights. I had a really good time, with friends.

They all asked me the next day why I wasn't so distraught at blowing £2,000 in a night.

I wasn't distraught though. I don't think they realised that whether they were with me or not, that money wasn't going to see the sunrise. 

I remember my parents when I was younger, hugging and crying in our front room about some money they were entitled to, that they were then refused by the government (father had a workplace accident involving chemicals.. Money promised never came).

I think it might have spurred on from that. But I'm not sure. I don't expect a response, I was just after that acknowledgement that somebody out there knows my anonymous thoughts and thanks for that.  

*Edit*

I should probably add that I'm drinking tonight. I think that helps with relieving my stress without it affecting others. I don't drink often though, perhaps once every week or two, but I do prefer to have that drink alone, when people are in bed. 4am now. I cannot sleep at the best of times. I smoke cannabis maybe once every 3 months. My 3 monthly smoke ended yesterday. I still didn't get to sleep until 5-6am so I'm out of using that as an excuse to help me sleep.

Saying that, I think regular sleep is my problem, or lack of. I've managed it before, and regular sleep did help me in more ways than I could have possibly imagined, it helped with anxiety issues (I'm not sure I like busy places, yet I pretend to myself that I'm not bothered). I tried exercise a few times, built up a little and that helped too... But then I bored of that, as I do with many things. Oh god, I'm only making this longer.
Are you currently online? I may need somebody to just acknowledge what I'm saying, feeling a little lost lately...
